Connecting…

Real homes, measured to the centimetre

Rooms and whole flats people have drawn from their own tape measure, furnished with products from real shops. Open one to walk around it, see what’s in it and what it costs, or copy it as a start for yours.

My homes

A single room or a whole flat. Only you see these until you publish one. Publishing puts a copy in Explore, with a picture of the view you’re looking at.

Catalogue

Furniture, rugs and wallpaper from shops on Nido, with their real sizes. Place any of them in your rooms; the shopping list adds up the prices and links back to the shop.

For shops

List your products with their real sizes, a photo and a link to buy. People place them in their own rooms and see how they fit before they order. Wallpaper with its repeat and roll size shows up on walls, with the number of rolls worked out for them.
